source: nvidia-smi board telemetry; independent physical per-card samples, host America/Los_Angeles timestamps converted to UTC
columns_note: Power is instantaneous reported board draw. Utilization is the sampled NVIDIA GPU utilization percentage. Within-recorded-requests excludes tokenization/setup between requests. A max is a sample maximum. Handbook phase includes prompt generation and tokenization. Short request intervals can fall between samples.

window-incumbent.timing_basis: Outer public replay client window inferred from creation (rounded to second) and last write (traceback) of its initially empty stderr file; bounded for physical telemetry only.
